# SPE round 5 plan: invoice extraction

Round 5 tests one thing. Config S is config R with OCR cleanup skipped on two-column layouts. The run shows whether S fixes F9 and whether the cleanup tool improves anything at all.

**Assumptions.** The pasted text did not show four details, so I chose defaults for them:
- I assume round 4 ended at requirement R40 and disagreement D5. New rows are numbered R41 to R47 and D6. I will renumber them when I write the files if the files show different numbers.
- I name the grader checks `field_match`, `line_items_match`, `total_match`, and `layout_agreement`. If the grader uses other names, I will map these to them.
- Trials per invoice and the r04 spend come from `spe/evals/harness/r04-workflow.js` and the r04 run record.
- I read the prediction-log columns as metric, config, predicted, measured, naive (last measured), hit/miss, and which number was closer.

Nothing is written until you approve. All commits are local. Nothing is pushed.

## 1. Specify

### Proposals from round 4

| Proposal | Decision | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| P1: skip OCR cleanup on two-column layouts | Adopt as config S | It targets F9 directly, and S differs from R by one flag. |
| P2: add 15 scanned handwritten invoices | Reject for r05. Logged as D6. | Q at 0.93 is not a ceiling. The ceiling rule needs every config at the maximum, and R measured 0.88. New invoices need reference fields from the AP lead, and I cannot write those. Adding data in the same round as S would make two changes at once. |
| P3: drop config P | Adopt | Q is P plus one change, and Q beat P on every r04 metric. P costs money and tells us nothing about F9. P can come back if Q regresses. |

### Defaults for this round

You said only "go again", so these choices are defaults. You can override any of them at approval.

| Keep R in the run next to S | S vs R isolates the skip. R vs Q isolates the cleanup tool. With both pairs, each difference has one cause. |
| I tag each of the 60 invoices by layout (single or two-column) and by source (scanned or digital) from the page images. The tags go in `spe/evals/data/layout-tags.csv`. | Subset scores need these tags. The tags describe the input and are not answer fields. The agent never reads this file (R42). |
| Same 60 invoices, same AP lead references, same trial count as r04 | Q, R, and the r04 regrade then stay comparable. |

## 2. Predict

Configs: Q (unchanged control), R (unchanged), S (R plus the two-column skip). Each number starts from r04 where r04 measured it.

| Metric | Q | R | S | Grader check | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field accuracy, all 60 | 0.93 ± 0.03 | 0.88 ± 0.03 | 0.93 ± 0.03 | `field_match` | Q and R did not change, so they keep their r04 values. Q moved 0.03 from r03 to r04 with no change, and that sets the band. S runs Q's path on two-column invoices and R's path on the rest. |
| Line-item accuracy, two-column subset | 0.90 ± 0.06 | 0.65 ± 0.15 | 0.90 ± 0.06 | `line_items_match`, subset `two_column` | F9 says cleanup drops two-column line items. S skips cleanup there, so S should match Q. r04 has no subset number, so the bands are wide. |
| Total accuracy, scanned single-column subset | 0.90 ± 0.08 | 0.90 ± 0.08 | 0.90 ± 0.08 | `total_match`, subset `scanned_single_column` | R's r04 Why claimed this gain, but r04 never measured it. I predict no gain until a subset shows one. R and S take the same path here. |
| Layout check agreement with tags | n/a (no check) | n/a (no check) | 0.95 ± 0.05 | `layout_agreement` | New check. Two-column line tables have clear column gaps, but some invoices will be borderline. |

**How I will read the results:**
- S matches Q on two-column invoices and beats Q on scanned totals. In that case S becomes the lead config and F9 closes.
- S matches Q everywhere. In that case the cleanup tool costs money and adds nothing, and I propose dropping it in r06.
- S falls below Q on two-column invoices. In that case I check `layout_agreement` first, because the likely cause is a missed layout.

**Stop rule.** The r04 miss reset the hit streak to 0, so round 5 cannot end the loop.

## 3. Evaluate

### Harness steps

1. Add a `skip_on_two_column` flag to the OCR cleanup tool wrapper. The flag uses a page-1 layout check based on the x-positions of text blocks. R runs with the flag off and S runs with it on. The same code serves both configs.
2. Write `spe/evals/data/layout-tags.csv` with the columns `invoice_id`, `layout`, `source`.
3. Add subset filters and the `layout_agreement` check to the grader. Add selftest cases for both.
4. Copy `spe/evals/harness/r04-workflow.js` to `spe/evals/harness/r05-workflow.js`. Change the round, the configs, and the subsets.

### Gates, in order

| Gate | Pass condition | On failure |
|---|---|---|
| G1 Grader selftest | All cases pass, including the new subset cases and the tag completeness case | Halt and report. The grader is broken. |
| G2 Regrade r04 outputs as control | Q 0.93 and R 0.88 on all 60, each within 0.005. The r04 subset numbers are logged as control. The r05 predictions are not edited. | Halt and report. The grader is broken. |
| G3 Dry run | 4 invoices (2 two-column, 1 scanned single-column, 1 digital single-column) × Q, R, S × 1 trial. S makes no cleanup call on the two-column invoices and does call cleanup on the scanned one. There are no reads of tags or references. The hash check passes. | Fix the harness and rerun G3. A read of tags or references halts the round as a leaked key. |
| G4 Launch | G1 to G3 pass | |

### Workflow arguments

```js

  round: "r05",
```

### Cost estimate (unmeasured)

Round 5 runs three configs on 60 invoices, which is the same size as r04. Config S replaces config P. P's long prompt drops out, and S adds cleanup calls on single-column invoices only. I expect spend within 20 percent of r04. The regrade gate costs grader time only.

### Halt conditions

The round halts and I report on any of these: spend passes the budget cap, S reads tags or references, G1 or G2 fails, or a decision that only you can make comes up.

2. Add the round 5 table to `spe/spec/spec.md`. Mark P1 and P3 adopted and P2 rejected in the "Proposed for round 5" section. Add D6 to `spe/spec/disagreements.md`. Change F9 to "Fix: r05 config S, pending measurement".
